proof_review.capital_and_timing: Fixed-debt marked loss changes equity one-for-one; sales at marking price repay debt without changing conditional equity. Immediate debt repayment versus retaining injected cash correctly gives distinct capital needs. Positive equity and exposure scope explicit.
proof_review.insurance: Compact nonnegative resource set, continuous shifted utility and strict concavity give unique global optimum. FOC and resource equation derive the interior allocation with positive numerator restriction. Independent derivative bisection and feasible-allocation comparisons verify both liquidity fractions. Storage and long technology are fully funded.
proof_review.withdrawal_game: Both no-run and all-run profiles checked as individual best responses in the stated atomistic simultaneous game with exchangeable random queue. For c1>1 liquidation exhausts resources, finite u(0) makes joining strictly better than unilateral waiting. Log substitution invalidates the strict expectation comparison. Patient access to storage and nontradeable full deposits are explicit.
proof_review.suspension_and_guarantee: Waiting inequality holds for every served mass through positive constant numerator divided by 1-w. Unpaid claimant retains late share, so positive service probability makes patient withdrawal strictly inferior. Known early mass/enforceability essential. External date2 guarantee G>c1 funds every history because unit mass times per-person topup never exceeds G; normal zero transfer is not a cost-free-policy theorem.
proof_review.feedback: Price-taking bank retention objective and outside buyer concavity are stated primitives. Cap and inverse demand give quadratic; every candidate requires positive price/equity, nonnegative debt, holdings and buyer affordability. Both original roots feasible, flatter-demand large root outside holding domain, peak debt boundary and no-root regime correct. Derivative means convergence of specified iteration only.
proof_review.capacity_pricing: Normal MGF over signed financial wealth exactly gives strictly concave quadratic; clipped cash-cap demand globally optimal. On open (0,mu), min of strictly decreasing branches is strictly decreasing; endpoint limits and strict supply bound prove unique positive price. Cash/mandate feasibility, outside seller transfers and CARA wealth-independence distinguished. Independent active-set enumeration verifies all displayed prices and holdings.
proof_review.instruction_and_limits: All five complete worked cases prepare twelve exercises. Complete determinate solutions and explicit ten-point memo rubric, answered teach-back and retention are present. No current regulatory ratios, historical calibration, causal crisis estimate or universal policy ranking asserted.
